extraction.title: Alpha trial
extraction.subtitle: Elon Musk and Sam Altman bring their rivalry to court Of the two unloved billionaires, which will the jury trust?
extraction.summary: The trial between Elon Musk and Sam Altman began on April 27, 2026, with significant implications for OpenAI and the AI industry. Musk alleges that Altman and co-founder Brockman misappropriated OpenAI's charity status for personal gain after Musk's departure from the board in 2018. The case highlights the rivalry between the two billionaires and the evolving landscape of AI funding.
